top_signals.title: China’s Market Regulator Warns of Global Asset Repricing Risks
top_signals.summary: Global capital markets are undergoing a new round of asset repricing and rebalancing in the face of geopolitical tensions and policy uncertainty, according to Wu Qing, chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Troubled Sherritt Misses Payment as Liquidity Crisis Deepens
top_signals.summary: Sherritt International Corp. missed an interest payment on secured notes, deepening a liquidity crisis for the troubled Canadian miner hobbled by US sanctions that forced it to halt production in Cuba.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.
